item.text: To request a room, submit the date and time you would like to use it. The booking team will then check whether the room is available during that period. After you submit your request, you will receive a message confirming that it has been received. This message does not mean your booking has been approved. Your reservation is only confirmed when you receive a separate notice saying that the room is available and your request has been accepted.
